beats.label: THE FIX
beats.note: Last step: turn it in, then check.

copy.caption: A made-up story: Diego finished his homework, but it stayed in his bag. The fix: make the last step “turn it in, then check.” Done means turned in. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Diego Finished But Never Turned It In: The Last-Step Fix
copy.pin_title: Done Means Turned In: A Last-Step Habit for Teens
copy.pin_desc: A made-up story about Diego and the habit that makes homework count: turn it in, then check. From the Julia Redmond executive function series for teens.
